name: The Ravel bomber runs past a near enemy into a tight block and bursts there
notes: Aiming at a crowd (ContentDef.aim, the owner's yes of 2026-10-21): a lone Ravel bomber, a lone Citizen trooper six columns on and four rows up (14 away), and a block of nine troopers further on (22 away). A unit that aims at the nearest would go for the lone trooper; the bomber counts the troopers round each one within its burst (radius 4: four columns across, two rows up and down) and runs for the block, past the lone one, bursting on contact as the block closes on it: seven of the block are caught, each trooper survives one burst at 36 (40 health), and the lone trooper, chasing it, is left behind and not caught. A bomber that bursts on contact names no killer of its own.
